Prior runtime binding is separate attribution evidence, not unique historical deployment/build provenance or a deployed-system proof.

Standard EVM rollback and Solidity checked uint arithmetic; trust compiler, verifier/solver and supported Halmos constructor/prank/deal/warp/assume/call semantics. Recorded source build uses solc0.8.34,optimizer200,Cancun; later completion records Forge1.8.1,Halmos0.3.3,Certora8.19.2,OpenJDK21.0.12.1. Compilation acceptance is not proof success.

Real production role/state stores retained. Distinct keys where required assume ordinary collision-free Solidity storage addressing. Proxy own, RateLimits own and shared AccessControls are separate stores; shared grants do not transfer authority. No Beacon store or whole-system authority theorem follows.
Storage addressing and relevant keccak keys/snapshots rely on collision freedom; no cryptographic theorem. Snapshot dependence applies only to observations using snapshots, not every rule.

Halmos PASS applies to its executed function, ABI domains, constructed states and supported semantics. bounds[] does not erase ABI widths or assumptions. Certora arbitrary prestates need a source-justified domain or independently established reachable structure; non-vacuity alone is not positive-path success.
One targeted kill per accepted mutation closure demonstrates discrimination, not mutation completeness. A timeout/parser/model failure is not a kill. C02 has no executed accepted mutation closure.
